name: PandaX-xT
summary: PandaX-xT is a proposed next-generation xenon observatory at Jinping. Its large low-background target is intended to extend dark-matter searches together with solar-neutrino and xenon-136 neutrinoless double-beta-decay studies.
detection_principle: A large dual-phase xenon time projection chamber combines scintillation and ionization measurements. Energy reconstruction, self-shielding and event topology support several neutrino and rare-event channels.

status.label: Proposed
status.evidence: The collaboration described a future observatory and sensitivity forecasts; these are not results from an operating xT detector.

phases.description: A separate intermediate detector is under construction in 2026. It must not be mistaken for a completed full PandaX-xT design.

science_scope: A neutrinoless double-beta-decay signal would establish lepton-number violation. Converting a half-life constraint into an effective Majorana mass requires a decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements; a null search is not a neutrino-mass measurement.
